notes: Approved escalation text (FR-07). Spoken verbatim by the server; the model never rephrases it. Never claims emergency dispatch. GENERAL is used when the assistant reports a warning sign the lexicon does not match. Wording is appliance-neutral because the lexicon applies to every appliance.

hazards.speech: Please leave the room now and get help from someone nearby. Don't try to put out an electrical fire with water.
Please stop using it and switch it off if you can do that safely, then keep away from it. I'll help you get a demo technician to check it.
Please move away from it now and keep the room clear. If there is fire, leave the room and get help from someone nearby.
Please don't touch it and keep away from it. I'll help you get a demo technician to check it.
Please don't touch it again and keep away from it. If you feel unwell, ask someone nearby for help.
Please leave it switched off and don't keep turning it back on. I'll help you get a demo technician to check it.
Please keep away from the wet area and don't touch the switch or plug. I'll help you get a demo technician to check it.
Please don't touch anything near the wires and keep away. I'll help you get a demo technician to check it.
Please stop using it and keep away from it for now. I'll help you get a demo technician to check it.
